sections.name: mission
sections.value: You are the cross-model Claude Opus reviewer for round 2 of plan 130-pij-rs-send-defaults. Review the rebased composed implementation in the PM worktree read-only, independently verify every AC and each round-1 remediation, and return only material findings the PM can act on.

value.text: Orient: read the plan (rendered .dd.md), the impl-guide (the intended decomposition + interfaces), and then the full diff of the branch against its base. DOGFOOD FLOWSPACE: use `flowspace3 search` to locate consumers/related code by meaning while reviewing; report misses as friction.
Review with the /builder review discipline: verify claims against fresh evidence — run targeted tests yourself, read exit status, never trust a green claim you did not see.

Your dispatcher OWES you three lists in this packet, and you should refuse to start without them: (1) WHERE THE AUTHOR IS LEAST CONFIDENT (hunt there first), (2) an instruction to DISBELIEVE THE AUTHOR'S OWN RECEIPTS (re-derive, don't audit prose), (3) WHAT IS ALREADY KNOWN-OPEN (spend zero findings re-reporting it). Proven 2026-08-28: this brief shape bought a 4-for-4 all-confirmed zero-noise review, including a defect the author hunted for in writing and could not see from inside.

Priority order: (1) plan promises that are not actually true, (2) composition-seam defects between units, (3) interface drift from the impl-guide, (4) correctness/safety in the changed code, (5) test gaps on the contract. Style noise is unwanted.
Findings: at most the material ones, each with severity (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM), exact location, the claim, the proof, and the smallest fix. `no_material_findings` is a valid verdict.
Deliver as a ddoc review record in the plan folder (assets/reviews/), build it, and send the PM the path + a one-line verdict.

WHERE THE AUTHOR IS LEAST CONFIDENT: verify all round-1 fixes first: contradictory PIJ_SESSION_ID+pane must refuse across send/report; explicit cross-seat --peek must work without actor identity while destructive reads still refuse; Queue::peek/service/HTTP must remain non-mutating; pane-bound adopt guidance must include omp/pi without regressing plan-128 harness-session registration.

DISBELIEVE THE AUTHOR'S RECEIPTS: re-derive behavior from the full diff and run your own targeted tests. Treat assets/live-send-defaults.md and PM test claims as hypotheses, not evidence, until independently checked.

KNOWN-OPEN: round-1 findings F1-F4 are claimed fixed and must be re-judged, not re-reported without testing the new code. Req-0044 excludes exactly two pre-existing TypeScript reds: harness/scripts/npm-resolution-policy.integration.test.ts replay status and .pi/extensions/pij/core/worktree.test.ts cleanup ENOTEMPTY; do not report those as plan-130 findings. Plan 128 is now rebased at main ac830c0e.
The PM is your counterpart: verdict and findings go to the PM; the PM may refute findings with evidence — re-judge refutations on the evidence, not on rank.
You do not fix code, commit, or open PRs. If you find something outside the plan's scope, name it as a note for prime rather than expanding the review.

value.fence: read-only on code; write only assets/reviews/ in the plan folder
value.forbidden_note: No code edits, no merges, no government files.

value.text: Every plan AC judged true/false with evidence cited.
Composition seams between units explicitly examined and reported.
Review record ddoc written, built, and path delivered to the PM with a verdict line.
